examples.text: Ладно, дай мне сейчас спокойно пройти.
examples.trans: All right, let me pass quietly right now.

examples.text: Вы спокойно всё сделаете.
examples.trans: You'll do everything calmly.

examples.text: Он сидел спокойно.
examples.trans: He sat calmly.

пройти.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

meanings.en: to go through, to pass; to come along
meanings.note: Russian perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to go through', forming an aspectual pair with 'проходить'; conjugates for person and number in the present/future and agrees in gender in the past tense.

examples.text: Ладно, дай мне сейчас спокойно пройти.
examples.trans: All right, let me pass quietly right now.

examples.text: Синяки у того парня давно прошли.
examples.trans: That guy's bruises healed a long time ago.

examples.text: Пройдите, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Go through, please.
